run_codespell_linter: run the codespell linter on one or more files to check for spelling mistakes
check_file_spelling: check a single file for spelling errors using the codespell library
check_dictionary_duplicates: check the codespell dictionary file for duplicate entries, sorting issues, or forbidden words
format_error_message: format a codespell lint error message into a LintMessage named tuple with severity and description
run_codespell_subprocess: run the codespell library as a subprocess against a given file path using pyproject.toml config
